description.zh:
配置项的分类。目前支持如下分类

- CommonResourceConfig 通用资源配置
- DLCAutoRecycle  DLC自动回收
- DLCPriorityConfig DLC 优先级设置
- DSWPriorityConfig DSW优先级设置
- QuotaMaximumDuration Quota的DLC任务最大运行时长配置
- CommonTagConfig 标签设置
description.en:
The category of the configuration item. Valid values:

*   CommonResourceConfig
*   DLCAutoRecycle
*   DLCPriorityConfig
*   DSWPriorityConfig
*   QuotaMaximumDuration
*   CommonTagConfig

description.zh:
配置项的键。目前支持如下键：

- tempStoragePath 临时存储路径，只有CategoryName为CommonResourceConfig时才允许使用该ConfigKey
- isAutoRecycle 自动回收配置，只有CategoryName为DLCAutoRecycle时才允许使用该ConfigKey
- priorityConfig  优先级配置，只有CategoryName为DLCPriorityConfig或者DSWPriorityConfig时才允许使用该ConfigKey
- quotaMaximumDuration Quota的DLC任务最大运行时长配置，只有CategoryName为QuotaMaximumDuration时才允许使用该ConfigKey
- predefinedTags 工作空间预置标签，创建的资源必须带上标签
description.en:
The key of the configuration item. Valid values:

*   tempStoragePath: Temporary storage path. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to CommonResourceConfig.
*   isAutoRecycle: Automatic recycle configuration. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to DLCAutoRecycle.
*   priorityConfig: Priority configuration. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to DLCPriorityConfig or DSWPriorityConfig.
*   quotaMaximumDuration: Maximum run time of DLC jobs for a quota. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to QuotaMaximumDuration.
*   predefinedTags: Predefined tags of the workspace. Created resources must include tags.
The value of the configuration item.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace get-config --workspace-id 12340000002 --category-name CommonResourceConfig --config-key tempStoragePath --verbose oss://000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/workspaces/12340000002/config --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigKey tempStoragePath --Verbose 'oss://000' --CategoryName CommonResourceConfig --header "Content-Type=application/json"
